jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.location: New York, NY (1372 Broadway); hybrid, regular office presence
jobs.salary: $84,700–$136,150 base; only upper portion meets $100K target

missingKeywords: 3–5 years of dedicated IT systems experience
